The '''Dee'ja Peak Capitol''' was the building situated in [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] that served as the [[City/Legends|city's]] capitol. The capitol building was in operation by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], and was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DeejaPeakCapitolInterior.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The interior of the Dee'ja Peak Capitol]]
The Dee'ja Peak Capitol was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
